vertebrae.cli
=============

.. py:module:: vertebrae.cli

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Command line interface for distributed vertebrae workflows.

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: main(argv = None)

   Run the vertebrae CLI.

   :param argv: Optional argument vector. Uses `sys.argv` when omitted.

   :returns: Process exit code.


.. py:function:: build_parser()

   Build the CLI argument parser.

   :returns: Configured argument parser.
